timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,364.79 Cr (+14.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹46.97 Cr (against a loss of ₹93.15 Cr a year earlier).
Arvind Fashions reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,266 Cr (+14% YoY) and net profit of ₹124 Cr.
Arvind Fashions Limited hosted a conference call with analysts/investors on May 07, 2026, discussing Q4 and FY2026 financial performance; audio recording available.
On May 7, 2026, Arvind Fashions hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, reporting 14% annual revenue growth and guiding for mid-double-digit growth in FY27.
Aura Securities Private Limited, as promoter, disclosed holding 46,906,356 Arvind Fashions Limited shares as of March 31, 2026, with no new encumbrances.
